title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Sold by Zeke Capital Advisors LLC

organizations.name: zeke capital advisors llc zeke capital advisors llc

text:
Zeke Capital Advisors LLC cut its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 9.2% during the second its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The firm owned 110,813 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 11,237 Apple makes up 1.9% of Zeke Capital Advisors LLC’s holdings, making the stock its 8th largest position. Zeke Capital Advisors LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $20,513,000
Several other hedge funds have also recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Delphi Private Advisors LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the second quarter worth about $120,000. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the first quarter worth about $133,000. Smart Portfolios LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the first quarter worth about $134,000. CX Institutional acquired a new stake in Apple during the second quarter worth about $135,000. Finally, Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC acquired a new stake in Apple during the first quarter worth about $138,000. 58.51% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
